panels.title: Disks
panels.description: One row per disk. Health = the drive's own SMART verdict. Warnings = NVMe critical-warning bits, or SATA attributes at/below their failure threshold. Bad blocks = NVMe media errors, or ATA reallocated + pending + uncorrectable sectors. Error log = entries in the drive's error log (Samsung PM983s count harmless ones: watch Bad blocks and Warnings instead). Wear used: NVMe 'percentage used'; SATA SSDs 100 minus their life-left attribute. Written: NVMe in bytes; SATA from the vendor's write counter (Intel: Host_Writes_32MiB). Last checked = the newest smartctl reading (every 5 min).
